messages:
priya: Quick design QA on the Capacity panel — users keep asking why the GPU pool and the SLO slider feel disconnected. In the current mock the SLO slider sits below Min/Max with no contextual link to the pool. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ZZZZ (frame 'capacity/controls-v3'). Thoughts?

mira: Good catch. Suggestion: add a small context row under the header that shows 'Active pool: nv4-48 • region: us-west' with an inline 'change' control. That way the SLO and Min/Max feel scoped to a specific pool.

devon: Implementation caveat: our pool metadata API is async and sometimes slow. We should render a skeleton and avoid layout shift. Also if user changes pool we need to validate the current Min/Max against new pool quotas.

alex: For a11y we should make the 'Active pool' info a button (role=button) so keyboard users can open the pool picker. When burst is enabled the button can have aria-disabled=true but still focusable with aria-describedby explaining why.

sara: Copy idea for the context row: "Active GPU pool: nv4-48 — used by this capacity config." Keep change as a link-style button. Also recommend adding a tiny help icon next to the SLO label: 'SLO defines the target latency percentile to scale for.' Tooltip copy: 'Set the latency percentile (p50/p95) the autoscaler should optimize for.'

jamie: UX nit: the SLO slider currently uses percent + a tooltip, but the values aren't persisted in URL or saved draft. Users expect to preview how Min/Max changes affect projected cost. Can we surface an estimated cost delta inline when slider moves? even just a small line: '+~$12/hr at 2x burst' would be helpful.

priya: Agree — cost preview is high value. Let's make it optional (toggle) in the right rail to avoid clutter for advanced users. Toggle label: 'Show cost estimates'.

devon: Also add guardrails: if SLO slider is set below a threshold (eg p50) show a warning: 'Low SLO may cause underprovisioning for tail latency.' Suggest small amber row instead of modal.

alex: Technical note: live updates to cost and warnings should use aria-live="polite" to announce changes to assistive tech. Also ensure the SLO slider is keyboard manipulable with arrow keys and has a visible focus ring.

sara: Accessibility + copy: label the slider 'SLO (latency percentile)' and the helper: 'SLO (target percentile) — higher values prioritize tail latency.' Short tooltip for guardrail: 'Setting very high SLOs may increase cost.'

jamie: UX pattern question: if a user toggles Burst on, should the cost preview instantly reflect potential burst charges? I think yes, but show 'estimated' and a link 'why burst costs more'.

priya: OK actionable list: 1) Add Active pool row with skeleton state and keyboard-focusable change button; 2) Make pool button focusable/aria-describedby when Burst locks it; 3) Add SLO helper icon + tooltip copy; 4) Add optional cost preview toggle in right rail; 5) Add non-modal amber guardrail for risky SLOs; 6) Ensure aria-live for cost/guardrail updates. I'll update the Figma and drop comments where to render skeletons.

mira: Thanks. Minor copy tweak for the Active pool line: 'Active GPU pool: nv4-48 — region: us-west' (remove 'used by this capacity config' to keep it brief). For the cost preview toggle label: "Show cost estimates (beta)".

alex: I'll prototype the accessible slider and aria-live region. Will add code sample in the PR for the skeleton + live region.

sara: I'll run a quick contrast and keyboard pass once Figma updates are in. If anyone wants, I can test NVDA with the skeleton+live region.

priya: Great — will post updated frames in ~2 hours. Thanks all :rocket:
